What we do

Pest control services

Four problems we solve every week for Fremont homeowners — treated properly, not just sprayed over.

Cockroach Control

Roaches hide deep in kitchens, bathrooms and wall voids. With years of experience treating cockroaches, we target the harbourage — not just the bugs you can see — and give you your peace of mind back.

Get a free quote

Rodents & Screening

Say goodbye to rats and mice. Our rat trapping programs remove the animals already inside, and our rodent proofing and screening service seals the entry points so the next ones can't follow.

Get a free quote

Wasp Service

Reliable pest control for wasp and bee infestations, handled with years of experience. If a nest is building on your eaves, fence or yard, let us know how we can help — before someone gets stung.

Get a free quote

Gopher & Mole Program

Mounds in the lawn and tunnels under the garden mean gophers or moles are at work. We run both bait and trapping programs to stop the damage and protect your yard.

Get a free quote

About us

Fremont's go-to pest crew

Go For It Pest Solutions is a licensed and bonded pest control company based on Osgood Road in Fremont. We handle the pests that actually show up in East Bay homes — cockroaches in the kitchen, rats in the attic, wasps in the eaves, and gophers tearing up the yard — with trapping, baiting, proofing and treatment programs matched to the problem.
